business_summary: FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of industrial rubber components in Japan, the United States, China, and internationally. The company operates through Industrial Materials, Fabric Processing Products, Sporting Goods, and Other segments. The company manufactures and sells industrial materials, including pneumatic control equipment, anti-vibration table and peripheral equipment, electrical and electronic equipment, rescue and lifesaving equipment, and carbon golf shafts. It also offers gas/water housing equipment, connection materials, and materials for speakers. In addition, the company provides automobiles, such as check valves; automotive parts; calendared rubber; industrial equipment, including duct quarter vent rubber/butterfly, and BF and AB cylinders; calendared rubber, such as anti-vibration system, rubber coated fabric, and pressure regulator; ultra-low hardness material and anti-vibration rubber products; paper roll airbags; conductive rubber, and textile/material for clothing. Further, it offers emergency magnesium air batteries; blade protective sheets for wind turbine; various functional tapes and molded products, cold shrink tube, and conservators for electric; LIM molded products; dialyzers, infusion, and blood circuits; check valves; regulator; flow control valve; latex products; disaster-relief tents, air tents, and inflatable life rafts and jackets; golf shaft for golf clubs; caravan shoes for trekking, hiking, trail running, and nordic walking; stream walking and climbing; and climbing/bouldering shoes. The company was formerly known as Fujikura Rubber Ltd. and changed its name to FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. in April 2019. FUJIKURA COMPOSITES Inc. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

Okamoto Industries, Inc. manufactures and sells industrial and household products in Japan, North America, Asia, and internationally. It offers industrial products, including plastic films for general goods, stationery; wallpaper for housing, decorative films for kitchen cabinets, doors, building materials, moldable ABS and acrylic sheets, and synthetic leather for sofas and furniture; automotive materials; agricultural films/work materials; and food wrapping films, absorbent/dehydrant sheets, gloves, and other food sanitation materials. The company also provides adhesive tapes and rubber bands; flexible container bags; medical/welfare products comprising wound dressing materials, medical gloves, autoclaves, masks, and other sanitary materials; and industrial products, such as cleanroom gloves, adhesive mats for entrances, partition films, safety shoes, and other products. In addition, it offers household products consisting of condoms/lubricants, heat patches/heating pads/hot water bags, health goods, portable sanitary products, and gloves; dehumidifiers, cockroach control products; absorbent/dehydrant sheets, food wrapping films, and sheets for cooking; rubber boots, safety shoes, and marine wear; and leather shoes and sneakers. Further, the company engages in the logistics and solar power generation business. Okamoto Industries, Inc. was incorporated in 1934 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

Fines inc. provides video production services in Japan. It offers video distribution platform; marketing data centralized management tools; and DX consulting; and reskilling training and e-learning services, as well as security solutions. The company also provides online reservation systems. Fines inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

PORTERS Corporation develops and provides cloud solutions for the human resources business in Japan. The company operates through the HR Tech Business and Global HR Tech Business segments. It offers PORTERS, a cloud-based comprehensive matching management system for recruitment agencies, temporary staffing companies, and other companies involved in human resources matching services. It also provides various support services, such as data migration, screen optimization tuning, various setting support, consulting for introduction support, and data maintenance services. In addition, the company offers API functions for linking with other systems or in-house systems, as well as publishes Porter's magazines. Its solutions include various functions, such as job seeker/resume management, client/recruitment management, interview scheduler, selection process management, matching functions, customization, media cooperation, import and export of data, and homepage linkage, as well as the creation of one-click forms, and reports and dashboards. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

今も昔も、東も西も、“働く”ということは社会システムを下支えする基盤にあるものです。 雇用は、世界共通のインフラストラクチャーであり 人材ビジネスは生活の基盤を支える重要な要素です。 どんなに世の中が変化、進化したとしても、その変化、進化の一歩先に、人材ビジネスのソリューションはあるべきだと私たちは考えます。 ポーターズは、人材ビジネスを加速させるクラウドソリューションを提供することで、 雇用インフラの課題を解決に結びつけ、 人材ビジネスと、その先にある働く人たちの豊かな人生に よりそっていきたい。その想いをチームで共有し、 テクノロジーで世界の雇用にもっとも貢献する企業になります。 使命 Mission Matching, Change your Business 描く未来 Vision 行動指針 Value 5つのCore Values Five Core Values メッセージ Message 人材ビジネスを加速させ、 雇用拡大に貢献できる ポーターズへ 私たちポーターズの製品やサービスは、時代とともに変化、進化する人材ビジネスとともにあります。近年では労働力不足解消のために、AIやEPAといったテクノロジーも大きく進化しています。今後は、これまで経験したことのない速度で、加速していくでしょう。私たちは、その変化、進化の一歩先を見据え、課題を見つけ、解決に導くソリューションを提案できる企業でありたいと考えています。それが、お客様やパートナー様の人材ビジネスを加速させるために求められることだからです。 ポーターズが提供する製品やサービスが、雇用市場において役に立っているか、お客様やパートナー様のビジネスに役立っているか。これまでも、そしてこれからも変わらないのは、この「役に立ちたい」という真摯な態度です。その想いをチームで共有し、お客様、パートナー様の課題に向き合い、解決策を提案し、ビジネスを成功に導くよう、今後も研鑽してまいります。新たなサービス、安定したサービスの提供を、最高のポーターズチームで取り組み、世界の雇用に貢献する企業を目指し、多様な人材ビジネスをサポートします。 business_summary: Linkers Corporation engages in business matching and research in Japan. The company offers Linkers Sourcing, a service which searches for companies, universities, and experts to solve technological challenges in the manufacturing industry; and Linkers Marketing for opportunities for meetings with companies that show interest. It also provides Linkers for BANK/Business, a SaaS-based business matching systems; Linkers Research, which conducts research into various technical fields; and TechMesse Academy, a coordination of technology service promotion events. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Terilogy Holdings Corporation provides cyber security solutions in Japan and internationally. It operates through Network Category, Security Division, and Solution Services Division segments. The company It also provides switches, routers, wireless LAN, and DNS/DHCP equipment; designs and constructs enterprise information and communication systems and infrastructure services; network operation, management, monitoring equipment and its own cloud performance monitoring services; professional services; maintenance of networks, ancillary equipment and software; cyber threat intelligence intelligent security services; firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention, information leakage measures, etc.; and security authentication infrastructures. In addition, the company offers one-time password products; log management and analysis cloud services; maintenance of security equipment and software products; software RPA tool (EzAvater); multilingual video interpretation services; cloud-managed VPN service; and web conferencing services. Further, it provides internet connection service for businesses; mobile data communication service; promotional businesses; and Information system development and operation services, as well as DX technologies. The company was formerly known as Terilogy Co., Ltd. Terilogy Holdings Corporation was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: POPER Co.,Ltd. provides a business management platform for educational institutions in Japan. The company offers Comiru, a SaaS-type business management platform that streamlines back-office operations of educational businesses. It also engages in developing BITCAMPUS, a platform that provides management suffort system for the cram school industry; ComiruAir, online classes and home learning support service; ComiruBASIC, a platform that improves operational efficiency; ComiruPay, which streamlines billing and payment operations; and ComiruHR, a labor management and communication service for instructors. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

tripla Co., Ltd. engages in travel agency and internet service business in Japan, the rest of Asia, and internationally. The company offers triplaBook, a booking engine for hotels; triplaBot, an AI chatbot for marketing and promotion; tripla Pay, an email-linked payment service collects cancellation fees; triplalink, a tool for overbookings and to manage accommodation reservations through online channels; and triplasuccess, which reduce workload by supporting facility management. business_summary: OpenWork Inc. develops and manages a job and recruitment information platform in Japan. The company operates OpenWork, a one-stop job and recruitment information platform incorporating company reviews and salary information; OpenWork Recruiting, a direct scouting service; and Job Satisfaction LAB, which publishes various job- and recruitment-related reports, as well as offers analysis and reporting services to support companies' management and organizational development. It also provides alternative data services on Japanese companies. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. OpenWork Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Link and Motivation Inc.

Achilles Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of shoes, plastic products, and industrial materials in Japan and internationally. It offers construction and civil engineering products, including heat insulation materials, interior materials, landscaping materials, plumbing material, and civil engineering materials; manufacturing and facilities products, such as films and sheets, rubberized fabrics, soft urethane foam, expanded polystyrene foam, and rim molding for large scale molding; and electrical machinery and electronics comprising anti-static products, packaging materials for wafers and electronic device, and conductive materials. The company also provides vehicle accessories, including synthetic and vinyl chloride leather, and laminated goods; and agriculture and livestock products, such as greenhouse horticulture materials and building materials for agriculture and livestock. In addition, it offers disaster prevention and lifesaving, as well as evacuation shelter support products; living and leisure products comprising household items and inflatable boats; and shoes under the MEDIFOAM, ALL DAY Walk, SYUNSOKU, Achilles SORBO, and MONTRRE brands. Achilles Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Nishikawa Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber and sealing products in Japan, North America, East Asia, and Southeast Asia. It offers automotive-related products, such as door outer seal, door inner seal, back door seal, door hole seal, grass run channel, waist seal, food seal, charging port sticker, convertible header, convertible roof side, and door outer seal for convertibles. The company also provides housing-related products, including joint gaskets and sealing backup material; civil engineering-related products, such as flexible joints for sewerage systems; and cosmetic related products comprising makeup puff, konjac sponge, and hiroshima lemon puffs. Nishikawa Rubber Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

business_summary: Asahi Rubber Inc. manufactures and sells industrial, and medical and sanitary rubber products in Japan. It operates through Industrial Rubber Business, and Medical and Sanitary Rubber Business segments. The company offers optical products, including ASA COLOR LED and ASACOLOR LED-EMMO, which are light source products; ASA COLOR LENS, a silicone lens solution; white silicone inks; light diffusion caps/color caps; and lamp caps for automotive interior lighting, as well as phosphor sheet/tubes. It also provides medical/life science products comprising silicone sheets, medical gaskets, check valves, and rubber plugs; and communication products, such as silicone rubber phantoms and soft protective covers. In addition, the company offers automotive rubber switches; flexible thermoelectric modules; products for wind turbine blades that include plasma actuators, divertor strips, and protective sheeting and shells; and molecular adhesion technology products, saporous foams, O-rings, and rubber for table tennis rackets. Asahi Rubber Inc. was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

朝日ラバーでは、将来のお医者さんや看護師を目指す方のサポートや若手医師のステップを助ける医療向け学習ツールを産学官連携で共同研究し、製品化しています。注射や採血などの練習をするための穿刺シミュレーターや、大腸の内視鏡検査を練習できるモデル、心臓を取り巻く血管の位置関係を学習するためのCAトレーナーなど「難しい手技」や「学生の分からない」を手助けしています。 レベラップ（穿刺シミュレーター） 株式会社朝日ラバー（本社：埼玉県さいたま市、代表取締役社長：渡邉陽一郎）が開発・販売する「ナノシート電極」が、このたび、繊維製品などの品質試験・機能性評価を行う第三者試験機関であるボーケンガーメンテック株式会社（本社：大阪府貝塚市、代表取締役社長：久次米正弘、以下「ボーケンガーメンテック社」という。）の筋電位測定評価に採用されましたのでお知らせいたします。 極薄・高密着を実現した「ナノシート電極」の特長 当社が独自で開発した「ナノシート電極」は、生体適合性を持つシリコーンゴムと導電性高分子（PEDOT:PSS）で構成された電極です。厚みを1,000nm以下まで薄膜化した極薄のシートであり、専用のケーブルを含めてもその厚みはわずか0.2mm以下です。 粘着剤を使用せず、水を使ってタトゥーシールのように肌へ直接貼り付けることができます。肌への刺激を確認する24時間閉塞パッチテストにも適合しており、装着時の違和感が極めて少なく、一般的な電極と同等に電気信号を読み取ることが可能です。 ※導電性高分子 PEDOT:PSSという導電性高分子を使用しております。導電性ポリマーの一種で、ポリ(3,4-エチレンジオキシチオフェン)（PEDOT）とポリスチレンスルホン酸（PSS）から成る複合物の略称で、他の導電性ポリマーに比べ、透明性、成膜性に優れています。 ナノシート電極 衣料品などの機能性・快適性を測る筋電位測定に活用 ボーケンガーメンテック社では、アパレルメーカーやスポーツ用品メーカー、作業服メーカーなどからの依頼を受け、衣料品や日用品の機能性および快適性の評価を行っています。当社のナノシート電極は、そうした評価の一環である筋電位測定（筋肉の活動量の評価）に使用されます。 具体的な測定例として、以下のような場面で活用されています。 靴の種類による歩行時の足裏筋活動の比較（安定性や踏み込みの違いの検証） 軍手や作業用手袋を着用してペットボトルを握った際の手のひら筋活動の比較（作業負担の検証） ナノシート電極を手のひらに貼り付けた例 手のひら筋活動の測定に利用できます 靴や手袋の中などの狭い空間でも自然な動作を妨げない優位性 従来のゲル電極などの表面筋電位電極は約3mmの厚みがあり、靴や手袋の中などの狭い空間に装着すると、違和感や不快感により被験者の自然な動作が制限されるという課題がありました。 当社のナノシート電極は、厚みを極限まで減らしながらも従来の電極と同等の測定性能を維持している点が高く評価されました。電極を貼っている感覚を忘れるほどの薄さにより、従来は困難であった靴や手袋などを装着した状態や手のひら・足の裏などの凹凸が複雑な部位でも、自然な動きを妨げることなく筋電測定を行うことが可能となります。 製品の使いやすさを定量化し、より快適な製品開発に貢献 ボーケンガーメンテック社に本電極が採用されたことで、実際の生活環境や使用環境に近い、自然な動作のまま生体データを取得できるようになりました。これにより、靴や手袋が人体に与える負担や製品の使いやすさを定量的なデータとして客観的に可視できます。例えば、少ない力でも物を保持できる作業用手袋などの負担軽減効果を具体的なデータで提示することが可能です。 客観的で精度の高い第三者評価データが提供されることで、各メーカーにおける、より快適で使いやすく、人への負荷が少ない製品の開発推進に大きく貢献できると期待しています。 当社では2026年4月から中期経営計画をスタートさせ、2030年とその先に向けて、モビリティ、医療、スポーツ・健康、生活の市場のウェルネス領域に向けた事業展開に取り組んでいます。このたびの「ナノシート電極」は、自然な動きを妨げずに人の動きにおける筋電測定を行うことができることから、市場のウェルネス領域に貢献できる技術・製品になります。当社は今後も、独自の技術を活かした製品展開を通じ、センシング分野および社会の発展に貢献してまいります。 business_summary: Fukoku Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rubber, metal and synthetic resin, and bio and medical related products in Japan, Southeast Asia, India, the United States, Europe, China, South Korea, and internationally. It operates through the Functional Products Business, Anti-Vibration Business, Life Sciences Business, Metal Processing Business, and Hose Business segments. The company offers wiper blade rubbers that are used in automobiles, railways, ships, and aircrafts; and seal products, which are used in automobiles, pneumatic devices, and industrial machinery. It also provides anti-vibration products comprising suspensions, rotating systems, and engine accessories for automobiles; shock absorbers and railroad track pads for railcars; and construction and industrial machinery. In addition, the company offers standard, semi-custom, and nonmagnetic ultrasonic motors; and ultrasonic atomizer products. Further, the company provides cell culture bag products; OA-related products, such as digital photo printer rollers and pads, and ink jet printer components; urethane products and microchannel chips; dampers, mounts, and urethane; metal parts for trucks and construction machinery; and hoses and other rubber products. The company was formerly known as Fukoku Rubber Industry Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Fukoku Co.,Ltd. in January 1986. Fukoku Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1953 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

business_summary: Nitta Corporation engages in the provision of power transmission belts, conveyor belts and units, and other products in Japan, rest of Asia, Oceania, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Belt and Rubber Products Business; Hose and Tube Product Business; Chemical Products Business; Other Industrial Products Business; Real Estate Business; and Management Guidance Business. It offers power transmission and conveyor belts, including PolySprint, Polybelt, and Super Endless belts; curve belt list; and conveyor units, such as curve, spiral, non-snaking, and junction conveyor systems. It also provides Hose and tube products comprising thermoplastic hoses and couplings, tubing and tube fittings, clean tube fittings, speed controllers and valves, and disconnect couplings; and industrial wipers and molded rubber products. In addition, the company offers air and chemical filters; filter casting and clean system equipment; bacteria decontamination equipment; particle and microorganism measuring instruments. Further, it provides mechatronics products, including automatic tool changers and interface units; Intelimer tapes; and RFID magnetic sheets. Additionally, the company offers SOFTmatics, a robot hand used for handling objects; and thermoplastic tubes, tubes and fittings for air brakes, and air spring. The company also engages in leasing land and buildings, and management consulting services; and offers polishing pads and slurry, and construction and waterproofing materials. It serves civil engineering and construction, automobile, logistic and transportation, environment and energy, industrial machinery, semiconductor, liquid crystal and electronic components, food, medicine, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Nitta Belting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nitta Corporation in 1982. The company was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Create Medic Co., Ltd. engages in the research, manufacturing, and sale of medical appliances in Japan, China, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers urology products, including all silicone foley, antibacterial foley, hematuria, tieman, suprapubic, and nephrostomy balloon catheters, as well as self-catheterization set, all silicone self-catheter for replacement, pure-cath, nephrostomy kit, cystostomy set, and all silicone malecot catheter; and gastroenterology products, such as all silicone ileus, stomach, and sengstaken blakemore tubes, as well as transanal ileus decompression tube set. It also provides PEG products comprising PEG kit pull-method, with loop fixture, and bumper type, as well as CLINY introducer PEG kit, loop fixture II, all silicone gastrostomy balloon catheter for replacement, balloon button set, facil button for replacement, gastrostomy replacement catheter set, all silicone PEG J catheter, and transgastric jejunal balloon tube and guidewire set; surgery products, which include PTC drainage tube, PTCD kit, cholangio-entero tube, and internal external drainage catheter for PTCD; all silicone endotracheal and tracheostomy tubes and micro catheter; and OEM products. business_summary: Sakura Rubber Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells specialty rubber products. The company offers firefighting products, including fire hoses, firefighting suction hoses, toxic substances measuring instruments, firefighting training and rescue apparatus, air respirators, emergency life saving tools, powered impact tools, air lifting bags, community disaster prevention apparatus, couplings for large diameter hoses, MVU fans and blowers, and rescue support systems, as well as mountain, hydraulic, and water rescue tools. It also provides aerospace products, such as various tube assemblies; PTFE hoses, rubber, lightweight hoses, dynatube fittings, AM products, machine parts, metal hoses, molded and extruded rubber, silicone and chloroprene rubber ducts, rubber sheets, inflatable rubber seals, thermal insulations, honeycomb mats, and Parker-Stratoflex division products. In addition, the company offers industrial rubber products comprising tank vapor seals; oil-resistant hoses for petrochemical plants; suction delivery hoses; tank lorry hoses; gate seals; joints; rubber sheets; pressed products; molded rubber; and insulation hoses for hydroelectric dams and levees. Further, it engages in the real estate business, such as operation of shopping malls. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. manufactures and sells belts and construction materials in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company offers automobile and motorcycle transmission belts and related products, such as timing belts, variable speed belts, v-ribbed belts, raw edge v-belts, worm wheels, and accessory drive systems; and industrial power transmission belts and related products, including v-belts for general industry and agricultural machinery, timing belts for general industry, RIBSTAR belts, polyurethane belts, FLEXSTAR belts, pulleys, and couplings. It also provides conveyer belts, systems, and related products comprising mamaline, LOGISTAR, and tailormade solutions; and engineering plastic materials and processed products, such as molecular weight and density polyethylene, cast-nylon, clean-PE products, polyacetal, polyetheretherketone, polyphenylenesulfide, and polytetrafluoroethylene. In addition, the company offers waterproofing materials for construction and related products; civil engineering water-shielding materials; electronic and coating materials consisting of conductive, metal, glass, pastes, and resistive pastes; copper sintering paste, cushioning materials, thick film solutions, metallized ceramic substrates, via-filling solutions, and decorative paints; and star wipers. It serves to automobile, two-wheelers, agriculture/forestry, industrial machinery, robot, money handling machine, logistics/transportation, construction/civil engineering, semiconductor/battery, food, medical/health, life, amusement, energy, printer, environment, and society applications. The company was formerly known as Mitsuboshi Chotai Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsuboshi Belting Ltd. in May 1961. business_summary: Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufactures and sale of automotive parts, industrial materials and high-performance elastomer products in Japan, China, Asia, Europe, America, and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Auto Parts Business, Industrial Materials Business, and High-Performance Elastomer Products business. It offers automotive power transmission belt products, such as power transmission belts and power transmission systems for auxiliary drive systems; motorcycle power transmission belt products; scooter gear shift belts, etc. The company also provides industrial power transmission belt products, such as industrial machinery V-belts, toothed belts, pulleys, etc.; other power transmission products; conveyor belts comprising resin conveyor belts, synchronous conveying belts; conveyor system products; and rice hulling rolls, etc. In addition, it offers cleaning blades, rollers, precision belts, polyurethane functional parts, precision polishing materials, films for construction materials, medical films, decorative display films, industrial films, and other products. In addition, it offers friction power transmission belts, synchronous power transmission belts, conveyor belts related products, light duty conveyance product, scraping sealing products, tension gauge sensor, resin products, film products, optical sheets cleaning systems, polishing materials, thermal management products, and other products. Further, the company provides robot-related devices, electronic materials, and medical equipment. Bando Chemical Industries, Ltd. was founded in 1906 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.

ものづくりセンター生産技術開発部：労働生産性、エネルギー生産性を達成させるための要素技術開発、製法開発を行う 事業部生産技術部：具体的な製品に対するスマート製法の開発を行う 製品のイノベーション：「環境対応製品」の拡充 自動車産業をはじめとする各種産業向けのベルト製品の開発に長年注力してきた当社は、お客様や社会のニーズに真摯に向き合うことで、省エネ関連技術を磨いてきました。現在、環境配慮型の自社ブランド“eco moving”製品、同ブランドの環境主張項目の基準値の2分の1以上を満たす製品、および有害物質削減製品を合わせて「環境対応製品」としてグルーピングし、拡大に取り組んでいます。CV-１の最終年度である2026年度には、上市新製品のうち、「環境対応製品」の占有率を50%以上とすることを目指しています。 2025年度は、12製品を新たに環境対応製品として認定し、上市新製品のうち、「環境対応製品」の占有率は63％となりました。 【eco moving 製品紹介】 eco moving 製品紹介ページ 【その他の環境対応製品】 EPDM製ベルト（廃棄時に配慮した原材料を使用） 非塩素系合成ゴムを採用した伝動ベルト 省エネルギー 基準製品に対して､製品使用時のエネルギーロスを15％以上滅らしている。 省資源 基準製品に対して、製品の原材料使用質量を10％以上減らしている。 廃棄物量削減 基準製品に対して、製品に関わるお客様側の廃棄物質量を10％以上減らしている。 リサイクル材料の使用 製品中のリサイクル材料使用質量が20％以上である。 エコ材料の使用 製品中のエコ材料（リサイクル材料および石油外天然資源材料）の使用質量が80％以上である。 カーボンオフセット カーボンオフセット認証制度（第三者機関）で認証を受け、適切なカーボンオフセットの取り組みを実施している。 CO₂排出量の削減 基準製品に対して、ライフサイクルでCO₂排出量を10％以上減らしている。 またはライフサイクルのいずれかの段階（原材料調達、生産、輸送、使用、廃棄）でCO₂排出量を15％以上減らしている。 CO 2 削減貢献量 当社グループは、製品を通じた社会全体の環境負荷低減や顧客の脱炭素への貢献を定量的に把握することを目的として、2024年度からeco moving製品（環境配慮型製品）を対象にCO 2 削減貢献量を算定しています。 2025年度のeco moving製品によるCO 2 削減貢献量は71,075t-CO 2 でした。これは当社グループの生産活動にともなうCO 2 排出量（SCOPE１・SCOPE2）の約87％に相当します。 算定にあたっては、GXリーグ「気候関連の機会における開示・評価の基本指針」、WBCSD「Guidance on Avoided Emissions（2023年発行）」に基づき、算定方法や数値の妥当性を担保するため、第三者の専門家の監修のもと、「CO 2 削減貢献量の手引き」を作成しました。この手引きに従ってCO 2 削減貢献量を算定しています。 当社グループは、今後も製品を通じた脱炭素社会の実現に貢献していきます。 お客様の課題解決に貢献する製品開発 ゴム堰用袋体 当社は1992年からゴム引布製起伏堰(ゴム堰)のゴム袋体を製造・販売しており、水資源の有効活用と治水・利水の両立に貢献していることから、2025年5月、国土交通省の「流域治水オフィシャルサポーター※」に認定されました。今後も気候変動への適応に寄与する製品開発などを通じて、流域治水の推進に積極的に取り組んでまいります。 ※ 気候変動の影響による水害の激甚化・頻発化を踏まえ、総合的な水害対策に取り組む 「流域治水」の理念に賛同し、具体的な行動を行う企業・団体に対して認定される制度 食品搬送用ベルト「ミスターLキーパー®」 食品搬送用ベルトは、搬送する食品に由来する油や粉が使用中にベルト裏面に潜り込むことや、加熱殺菌のための熱水洗浄等により、ベルトの波打ちや寸法変化といった問題が発生することがあります。こうした問題はベルトの蛇行につながるほか、ベルトを搬送機器から外し熱水洗浄することで収縮し、再装着できないといった不具合の原因となります。このため頻繁にベルト交換が必要となり、生産性の低下につながります。これら一連の問題を解決するべく、当社は、ベルト裏面の帆布を改良することで従来品よりもベルトの寸法変化を抑制し、低収縮性に優れた食品搬送用ベルト「ミスターLキーパー®」を開発し、2023年4月に販売を開始しました。 本製品は、前述の油や粉などの潜り込みによる寸法変化の抑制に加え、抗菌・防カビ、耳ほつれ防止機能、優れた耐湿熱性・耐薬品性、最高100℃までの熱水洗浄が可能です。 当社は今後も、人の暮らしや地球環境にやさしく、社会課題を解決する製品の開発に取り組みます。 電子機器の小型化・高効率化・高性能化に貢献する「熱マネジメント」製品 近年、自動車、鉄道、新エネルギー等のパワーデバイスにおける次世代半導体の普及に加えて、IoTやエッジコンピューティングの通信産業への適用が本格化するなど、様々な分野において電子デバイスの「小型化」「高効率化」「高性能化」への要求が加速度的に高まっています。これらの要求に対応するには、積極的に「熱をコントロール」する効率的な「熱マネジメント」が必要不可欠であり、緻密な熱設計に加えて、それを実現するための電子資材の高性能化が欠かせません。 当社は、「分散技術」を発展させたゴムやエラストマー加工技術などのコア技術を応用し、配向技術やナノ粒子創生技術を組み合わせ放熱効果を高めることで発熱を抑制する製品を開発し、熱マネジメントに最適な電子資材を生み出しています。窒化ホウ素伝熱フィラーで超高熱伝導率を実現した、高熱伝導シート「HEATEX®」、低温・無加圧接合を可能とする銀ナノ粒子接合材「FlowMetal®」など、電子機器製造におけるお客様の課題を解決する「特長ある製品」を開発・製造しています。 中期経営計画CV-1で「スマートものづくり創造」を指針2.に掲げ、「バンドー夢工場」実現に向けた布石としてAI、IoT等のデジタル技術を用いた人のスキルに頼らない製法（スマート製法）の開発を推進しています。2025年度は2024年度に選定した「バンドー夢工場」のモデルラインを対象に、無人化～自律化実現に向けた要素技術開発を推進しました。和歌山工場の対象ラインにおいては、AIやロボットを活用した装置を開発、投入することで一部工程を省人し生産性を大幅に向上させると同時に、労働力不足への対応も進めています。2026年度も継続して要素技術開発を推進し、同ラインの無人化実現を目指します。 あわせて、スマート製法開発を担うデジタル人材の育成にも注力しています。DX、AI活用のための社内教育や社外研修を通じて人材育成を実施しており、関連資格である「ITパスポート試験」、「Deep Learning for General（G検定）」などの資格取得を推進しています。 デジタル人材育成「AI研究会」 AIを用いた外観検査装置の開発 当社製品のSEQDC（安全・環境・品質・納期・コスト）のレベルアップに向けてAIの製造現場への適用を進めており、2019年度から、外観検査への適用を一部開始しました。今後も開発を継続し、外観検査における「検査作業者の育成に期間を要する」「作業者によるバラツキがある」「検査自体に工数がかかる」といった課題を克服していくとともに、生産量の変化への柔軟な対応も目指します。また、AIについては、外観検査装置だけでなく、広く製造現場への適用を進めていきます。 business_summary: Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of rubber products and precision equipment in Japan, Asia, Europe, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Medical Equipment; Precision Medical Devices; SP Business; and Food Container. The company offers shock and helical vibration absorbers; gas springs; and plastic, vane, and rotary dampers. It also provides condoms, balloons, and related latex products, as well as industrial purpose buffer products. In addition, it manufactures and sales food grade rubber containers, filing machines, and related products. Further, the company provides probe covers, intrauterine contraceptives, cervical dilators, and related products for medical sector. The company was formerly known as Japan Latex Industry Co., Ltd and changed its name to Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. in July 1961. Fuji Latex Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: AGC Inc. manufactures and sells architectural glass, electronics, chemicals, automotive, and ceramics worldwide. The company offers architectural glass products, including insulated, laminated, wired, toughened, solar control, sound insulation, decorative, float and patterned, and industrial glass, as well as structural glazing systems and industrial glass; automotive glass for displays, sensors and connected drive, windows, and trains; and glass substrates used for thin-film-transistor liquid crystal displays and OLEDs. It also provides synthetic fused silica glass, silicon carbides, CMP slurry, and through glass vias, and glass substrates for semiconductor packaging and anodic bonding; industrial PTFE composite materials and copper clad laminate; optical materials comprising high refractive index glass, DOE diffuser, wave plates, IR cut filter, aspherical glass lenses, micro lens array, and transmission grating; optical film, such as antireflection film, beam splitter, and interference filter; glass frit, pastes, and lid for hermetic sealing; tissue culture products; laboratory glassware; borosilicate glass tubes and rods; and heat resistant glassware. In addition, the company offers chlor-alkali, polyurethanes, fluoro, and specialty chemical products; high thermal insulation ceramics wall for furnaces and fine ceramics; and plasma-resistant coating for semiconductor manufacturing equipment and plastic optical fiber. Further, it provides contract development and manufacturing services for pharmaceutical and agrochemical components. The company was formerly known as Asahi Glass Co., Ltd. and changed its name to AGC Inc. in July 2018. AGC Inc. was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of glass and glass products in Europe, Asia, and the Americas. The company operates through Architectural, Automotive, Technical Glass, and Other segments. It offers flat glass and various interior and exterior glazing products within commercial and residential markets; and glass for the solar energy sector. The company also provides automotive products, including front and rear door, front and rear quarter, and front and rear vent glasses; and windshield, sunroof, and rear window glasses; and distributes glass for light, medium and heavy duty commercial vehicles, as well as off-road vehicles, bus and coach, and marine and rails. In addition, it offers information and telecommunication devices; functional products under the MICROGLAS brand name; and fine glass products, such as thin sheets, special glass for chemical strengthening, and anti-glare glass products. The company was formerly known as America Japan Sheet Glass Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippon Sheet Glass Company, Limited in 1931. The company was incorporated in 1918 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

This marks the first time NSG Group has been included in the prestigious "A List". Since 2011, NSG Group has consistently disclosed information on climate change and water-related initiatives through CDP, striving for high transparency in its reporting. Building on the leadership-level "A-" rating achieved in 2023 and 2024 for two consecutive years, the Group has continued to improve its performance, culminating in this year's highest rating of "A List". In addition, NSG Group's "Water security" score has also improved to an A- leadership rating. NSG Group has set a target to reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 30% by 2030 compared to 2018 levels, a goal validated by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). Furthermore, the Group aims to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050. These initiatives align with NSG Group's medium-term plan, "2030 Vision: Shift the Phase", which is driven by the "4D" strategies, including Decarbonization. Through a wide range of initiatives toward these goals, NSG Group is accelerating its decarbonization efforts and contributing to the realization of a sustainable society. * CDP CDP is a not-for-profit charity that runs the global disclosure system for investors, companies, cities, states, and regions to manage their environmental impacts on climate change, water security, and deforestation. business_summary: J-Pharma Co., Ltd. is engaged in the research and development of pharmaceutical drugs in Japan. The company researches and develops drugs targeting solute carrier (SLC) transporters, with emphasis on the LAT1 amino acid transporter. It is developing several compounds for various medical indications, including nanvuranlat (JPH203), a novel small-molecule compound identified as a selective inhibitor of LAT1 and provide treatment for biliary tract cancer, as well as for colorectal cancer; JPH034 is characterized as high brain penetrance and development for disorders of the central nervous system, including non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis and glioma; and JPT-0008 for solid tumor, autoimmune diseases, and rare diseases. It also conducting clinical trail for biliary tract cancer and JPH034. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: Nihon Yamamura Glass Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of glass bottles in Japan and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Glass Bottle Related Business; Plastic Container Related Business; Logistics Related Business; and New Glass Related Business. It offers glass bottles for sake, wine, whiskey, shochu, beer, food, seasonings, soft beverages, milk, chemicals, and other drinks; and sintering additive and general glass, glaze and overcoat glass, high heat resistance crystalized glass, and LTCC materials. The company is also involved in the manufacturing of plastic caps and other related products; and logistics business, including transportation, storage, and on-site operations. Nihon Yamamura Glass Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Amagasaki, Japan.

business_summary: Nippon Electric Glass Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells specialty glass products and glass glassmaking machinery in Japan and internationally. The company offers glass products for LCD/OLED displays and optoelectronics, chemical, and lighting; and ultra-thin glass, glass wafers for supporting semiconductors, glass substrates for probe cards, LTCC products, functional glass powders, cover glass for image sensors, and glass tubes for small electronic components. It also provides chopped strands for functional plastics reinforcement, wet chopped strands for building materials, roving for plastics reinforcement, chopped-strand mats for automobiles, and alkali-resistant glass fibers for cement reinforcement. In addition, the company offers glass tubing for pharmaceutical and medical use, radiation shielding glass, super heat-resistant glass-ceramics, fire-rated glass, glass blocks, and glass-ceramic building materials. Its products are used in televisions, displays, smartphones, automotive displays, electronic components, optical communication, buildings, civil engineering, fire-resistant glass, medical containers, and cooktop surfaces applications, as well as observation and operation windows in CT/angiography rooms. Further, the company provides solutions to healthcare, aerospace, semiconductor, infrastructure, glass engineering, automotive, information and communication, and housing equipment and building materials. Nippon Electric Glass Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1944 and is headquartered in Otsu, Japan.

business_summary: Ohara Inc. engages in the manufacture and sale of glass materials for optical and electronics equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers optical glass products for polished lenses and molded aspherical lenses; glass-ceramic products under the CLEARCERAM-Z, WMS-15, and NANOCERAM names; and GD-FHT, a glass disk for use in flying height testers. It also provides LICGC SP-01 membranes; LICGC PW 01 powders; i-line high homogeneity glass and non-browning glass products; and fiber glasses for light guide. Ohara Inc. was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

business_summary: Sumitomo Osaka Cement Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells cement and related products primarily in Japan. It operates through six segments: Cement, Mineral Products, Building Materials, Optoelectronics, New Materials, and Others. The company offers cement, cement-based solidification materials, electric power supply, recycling, and ready-mix concrete; limestone for steelmaking, road construction, aggregate, calcium carbonate, dolomite, antibacterial agents, cosmetic materials, various functional paints, and silica powder; optical communication components and measuring equipment; and ceramic products and nanoparticle materials. It is also involved in repair and reinforcement materials for concrete structures, heavy metal pollution control materials, cathodic protection (ELGARD SYSTEM), and fish reefs and seaweed beds; and real estate leasing, information processing services, and electrical construction work which utilize idle land. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Taiheiyo Cement Corporation engages in the cement, mineral resources, environmental, construction materials, and other businesses in Japan, the United States, and internationally. Its Cement segment offers ordinary portland cement, specialty cement, soil stabilizers, and ready-mixed concrete. The Mineral Resources segment sells limestone aggregate products comprising course and fine aggregate used in ready-mixed concrete, and aggregate used in concrete products and civil engineering; sandstone and andesite as aggregate materials; quicklime, slaked lime, filler, silica, and silica powder; and hollow ceramics, sepiolite, wollastonite, and kaolin. Its Environmental segment recycles used tires, waste plastics, paper sludge, waste casting sand, other industrial waste, surplus soil from water purification, sewage sludge, dredging sludge, and other wastes discarded from municipalities, as well as engages in the CFC treatment and building waste treatment plants; develops and commercializes environmental recycling technologies, including ash washing system and applied kiln system, and fermentation technology; supplies flue gas desulfurization materials, such as calcium carbonate; and sells slag powder and other inorganic materials, coal, heavy oil, and other fuels, as well as chemicals and gypsum. The Construction Materials segment produces precast concrete products; promenades, interlocking blocks, and concrete housing products; acoustic panels used to reduce construction noise; and fireproof covering materials used in tunnels. Its Other Businesses segment leases land for office buildings, commercial stores, leisure facilities, distribution warehouses, and other structures, as well as develops land for residential housing; and engages in the data processing, transportation and warehouse, engineering, chemical products, and sports business. Taiheiyo Cement Corporation was incorporated in 1881 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

note inc. engages in the media platform, and IP content and content creation business in Japan. The company offers note, a C2C content platform that allows creators to create, publish, and sell digital content while communicating with users; note pro, an information dissemination SaaS for corporations; note money, a platform which provides financial, articles, and investment information; and services for corporations, such as organizing corporate sponsored contests on note. It is also involved in production and sales, as well as planning and content production contracts from external companies. The company was formerly known as Piece of Cake, Inc. and changed its name to note inc. in April 2020. note inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: ELEMENTS, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides data-based personal authentication and optimization solutions as backend-as-a-service to service providers across various industries in Japan. The company offers LIQUID eKYC and Polarise eKYC, an online identity verification service; LIQUID Auth, an authentication service; PASS, a digital identity wallet; GPASS, a digital ID wallet for foreigners; office diagnostic report, which is a digital transformation service for office relocation and renovation; MyPlace for Home, a smart home/smart city platform; my IDEAL, a size matching service; Coordware, a personalized marketing for E-Commerce using generative AI; ELEMENTS cloud, a GPU cloud for AI development; and AiQ PERMISSION, an AI automatic refueling permit monitoring system. It also engages in the research and development of image recognition engines and data analysis platforms; offers optimization service for office living environment and biometric authentication service; and engages in construction of cloud environment construction and data center operation business, as well as engages in healthcare, web advertising, and medical supply business. ELEMENTS, Inc. was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

GMO Prime Strategy Co.,Ltd. provides cloud integration services in Japan. Its products include the KUSANAGI ultra-fast CMS platform and WEXAL page speed technology. The company provides KUSANAGI Managed Services, an integrated system for website maintenance and management of applications, middleware, and servers; CMS Platform integration services; WEXAL mobile display acceleration service; and hyper automation implementation services. It also provides cloud integration services, such as performance tuning; deployment of security tools, such as WAF, intrusion detection, antivirus; wordpress (website) construction and modification; and migration from various CMS to WordPress and Always On SSL. The company was formerly known as Prime Strategy Co., Ltd. and changed its name to GMO Prime Strategy Co.,Ltd. in February 2026. business_summary: Nihon Knowledge Co,Ltd. provides software system verification services, contract system development and business package development in Japan. It engages in the provision of software testing support; test automation support, such as test automation implementation consulting, support services, seminar, and methods for mobile devices; proprietary exploratory testing; business process automation support; and quality improvement support. The company also offers PowerSteel package for steel industry; Power Cubic, a package for building materials and lumber wholesale industry; DEFESA Logger complete synchronization of text logs and video data; DEFESA REC, a recording solution; monoPack, a security product; and mono + WEB Separation, a web separation solution. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Monstarlab Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the information technology business in the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas. It operates in two segments, Digital Consulting Business and Others. The company offers application and system, website, and e-commerce platform development, as well as AI and XR feature integration, API development and integration, and customer data platform implementation; and data warehouse, data integration infrastructure, and cloud application and infrastructure development, as well as legacy system modernization, digital twin implementation, and customer relationship management implementation. It also provides user research and strategic planning, ideation, service concept and customer journey design, prototyping, and implementation support and performance evaluation; visual identity, communication, and visual design, as well as brand concept development; and user interface and information architecture design, expert usability review, UX writing, and building a design system. In addition, the company offers idea generation support, strategic business planning, global and local market opportunity analysis, technology sourcing, and PoC/MVP development support; and digital transformation planning and support, digital infrastructure optimization, AI-driven and smart process transformation implementation, data-driven management promotion, and exploration of emerging markets and customer segments. Further, it is involved in offshore development, agile development implementation, maintenance and operations outsourcing, and provision of experts; and talent development program, skill transfer support, business process optimization, and implementation of workflow automation tools. The company was formerly known as Monstarlab Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Monstarlab Inc. in March 2025. Monstarlab Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

business_summary: Nova System Co.,Ltd. provides system integration for business system development, and cloud services. The company offers system integration; and develops system for various fields, including logistics, energy, trading companies, government agencies, and local authorities. It also provides cloud products, including Order Revolution, a restaurant management support system; iWelco, a reception support system; and iWelcotor, an access control system using AI facial recognition. In addition, the company offers ordering systems and POS systems for restaurants; and reception system for unmanned visitor handling and infection control. Nova System Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

In addition, it provides house electronic money services; nextore, a payment-driven DX service platform for small and medium-sized businesses; cashless payment service business; cloud point of sale solutions; and marketing tools. The company was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the hotel and golf operation businesses in Japan. It operates through six segments: Hotel Operation Business, Golf Operation Business, RESOL NO MORI Business, Welfare Business, Renewable Energy Business, and Investment Recovery Business. The company operates RESOL NO MORI sports and do resort, which provides relaxation, health, sports, and outdoor activities; golf courses; Fairway front Villa; and tourist hotels under the RESOL HOTELS brand name. It also engages in development of solar power generation facilities; provision of Life Support Club, a welfare services; and investment recovery business. The company was formerly known as Resort Solution Co., Ltd. and changed its name to RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. in October 2016. RESOL HOLDINGS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

「あなたのオフをもっとスマイルに。」を掲げ、革新的な発想と行動力で新たな価値創造に努めています。 リソルの森事業 リソルの森株式会社 グループの象徴的施設である体験型リゾート「Sport & Do Resort リソルの森」で展開する、リゾート・健康・スポーツ・アウトドアをテーマとした事業。 ホテル運営事業 リソル株式会社 リソル不動産株式会社 物語のあるホテルをコンセプトに、“リソルホテルズ”ブランドでツーリストホテルを全国20ヶ所に展開。 さらに、貸別荘事業の“リソルステイ”も約80ヶ所に展開。 ゴルフ運営事業 リソル株式会社 顧客ニーズとゴルフ場の適正に合わせた運営スタイルで全国に17コース（運営提携含）を展開。 フェアウェイフロントヴィラを中心に、ゴルフと宿泊をセットで提供する「GOLF&STAY」を推進。 ウェルビーイング事業 リソルライフサポート株式会社 グループシナジーの要である総合福利厚生サービス「ライフサポート倶楽部」で、企業と働く人々のウェルビーイングを応援。 再生エネルギー事業 リソル総合研究所株式会社 ゴルフ場の土地や建物に太陽光発電設備を開発し、売電と地産地消の2つの分野で事業を展開し、「地球にやさしい」企業グループを実践。 投資再生事業 運営施設のバリューアップ型再生、ゴルフ場にヴィラを建設するリゾート型再生、ゴルフ場の再エネ転用等、独自ノウハウで最適に施設を活用するソリューションビジネス。 動画でみる事業紹介 会社案内 Corpotate Profile Corporate Profile （会社案内） 【PDF】 Corporate Profile （English） 【PDF】 ご注意事項 business_summary: Nippon Hume Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of pipes and concrete piles in Japan. It offers pipeline products, such as fume tubes and synthetic steel pipes, box and arch culverts, assembly manholes, precast joint grooves, wellman products, jacking internal pressure pipes, propulsion tubes, and antibacterial concrete products; concrete piles; RC segments; and PC and composite wells, and press casts and PRC hollow piers. The company also provides multi-arch systems, precast guard fences, EMC wall railings, and wall railings; and valve boxes, infiltration box culverts, precast flood control basin, and eco concrete products. In addition, the company offers connect holes, precast basements, and other concrete products. Further, it is involved in the construction contracts, optical fiber cable laying, rehabilitation, earthquake resistance, and real estate businesses. The company was incorporated in 1925 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Asahi Concrete Works Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells concrete products in Japan. The company offers PC box, HTC Box, PRC box, large multi-section box, and PPCa box culvert, as well as box culvert for jacking construction; PC rainwater storage tank agua, new box-type agua, box culvert type rainwater storage tank, and PCa open regulating pond. It also provides emergency toilets; connecting halls, infiltration hall, and floating suppressing connect holes; waterways; fire prevention water tank; underground garage; railway and road related products; and hume pipes, PODs, underwater observation facilities, and amphibious vehicle access ramps. Asahi Concrete Works Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1923 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Nippon Concrete Industries Co., Ltd. design, construct, maintain, and sell concrete products. The company offers single and flange poles for infrastructure, such as power lines, telecommunication lines, mobile phone base stations, and electric railroads, as well as for lifestyle, including sports net poles, disaster radio poles, lighting poles, speaker poles, carp streamer support poles, wind power generation support poles, and drying poles for firefighting hoses; and pole accessories. It also precast concrete walls; and piles for construction, piles for civil construction, pile joint, pile head treatment, and geothermal power system. In addition, the company offers civil engineering products, such as tunnel shield and lining materials, box culverts, earth bracing retaining walls, ground anchors, concrete manholes and hand-holes, concrete walls for railway bridges, ultra-high-strength fiber-reinforced concrete, and precast concrete floor panels and construction materials; environmental materials; and soundproof materials, sound absorber and proof panels, and silencers. It operates in Japan and Myanmar. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells concrete products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Concrete Secondary Products-Related Business; Information-Related Business; and Others. The company offers pile products, including prestressed concrete, PRC, and SC piles, as well as construction management equipment and system, triple plate joints, and coupling and F.T. pile construction products; prestressed concrete poles and diameter poles; and waterwork materials, such as shake and surf blocks, surf flats and steps, surf flats L types, and tine block S types. It also provides gravel and stones for civil engineering construction, railway tracking and pavement roadbed materials, raw concrete, various concrete secondary products, aggregate of asphalt composite material, and construction materials; solar/pile systems; and environmental products comprising VS lateral grooves, L type retaining walls, block holding walls, box culverts, flumes, and H-form PC piles. In addition, the company is involved in hotel operation; office building rental; information-related solutions; and environmental hygiene businesses. Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1946 and is headquartered in Fukui, Japan.

Nihon Kogyo Co., Ltd. engages in the civil engineering, landscaping, and exterior design businesses in Japan. The company designs and manufactures concrete products, including box culvert, culvert, retaining wall, road, underground cables, waterway, river, ocean, special concrete, and dam related products used for roads, sewer, bank construction, artificial reef, disaster prevention and mitigation, as well as the maintenance and repair of infrastructure, such as highways, bridges, and tunnels. It also offers paving materials, furniture used in parks, wood cleats, construction products, and disaster prevention and mitigation items. In addition, the company provides gardening and pet-related products comprising garden sink, shower place, standing faucet unit, disaster prevention and mitigation, entrance and approach, around the garden, parking, raku shiba, exterior related materials, and other exterior products. Further, it manufactures and sells products for public spaces; and undertakes evil engineering and block construction. Nihon Kogyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1945 and is headquartered in Sanuki, Japan.

business_summary: Yoshicon Co.,Ltd. engages in the buying, sale, intermediation, leasing, management, and research of real estate properties in Japan. It also sells patent, utility model, design, and trust beneficiary rights; and construction and environmental materials. In addition, the company is involved in investment advisory; sale of electricity; and operation and management of parking lots and solar power plants, as well as attraction of commercial facility factories. Yoshicon Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Shizuoka, Japan.
